target_audience: Premium Italian homeowners looking for luxury wellness solutions (water purification, premium mattresses, relax armchairs).
vibe: Clean, pure, trustworthy, high-end Italian wellness. 'Portiamo salute, acqua pura e relax direttamente a casa tua.'

headings.usage: Elegant sans-serif, tight letter spacing for large headers (tracking-tight). No Inter for headings.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible body text. Loose line height (leading-relaxed).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use large paddings (p-12, p-16, p-24) to create a luxurious and airy feel.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-3xl for main cards/sections, rounded-full for buttons/pills.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Very soft, ambient shadows. e.g., shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(44,44,42,0.04)]
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use bento grids and asymmetric layouts (MODE A: TETRIS GRID) for product features to avoid standard bootstrap looks.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFCF0]/80, sticky top-0, z-50, soft bottom border border-[#AFA393]/20.
surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (#F5F3E9 or white), 1px subtle border, soft hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase.
surfaces.placeholders: Soft gradient backgrounds using brand accent colors, with a centered, elegant 'Immagine Prova' text label.

interactions_and_motion.hover: All interactive elements must have smooth hover states. Buttons scale very slightly or change background color.
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Soft fade-in and slide-up animations for sections as they enter the viewport using framer-motion.
interactions_and_motion.micro_interactions: Floating WhatsApp button with continuous soft pulse animation.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary CTA: dark background (#2C2C2A) with light text. Secondary CTA: outline with text color matching the border.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism navbar. Must include IT/EN language switcher. Links: Home, Acqua, Relax, Poltrone, Chi siamo, Showroom, Contatti.
components.cards: Problem cards: Minimalist, large icons/numbers, generous padding. Product cards: Image top, elegant typography below.
components.timeline: Vertical or horizontal timeline for 'Metodo CDM' (4 steps) with soft connecting lines and highlighted nodes.
components.accordion: For FAQ section. Minimalist styling, smooth expansion, no heavy borders.

hero_water.description: Luxury modern kitchen representing clean water at home. Use in hero or water section.

water_before_after.description: Water before/after comparison image provided by the user. Use in the Acqua section.

relax_bedroom.description: Premium luxury bright bedroom. Use in the Relax/Mattresses section.

relax_armchair.description: Luxury leather armchair in modern living room. Use in the Poltrone section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, airy, one-page marketing site using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Use Manrope for headings and Inter for body text. Enforce tracking-tight on large headings.
Implement a sticky navbar with glassmorphism and an IT/EN language switcher.
For sections lacking specific images, construct elegant placeholders using a soft gradient background (e.g., from water_secondary to relax_secondary) and center a text label saying 'Immagine Prova'.

Section Order: Hero, Problema (3 cards), Acqua (test, advantages, before/after), Relax/Materassi (products), Poltrone (products), Chi siamo (20 years), Metodo CDM (4 step timeline), Showroom, Finanziamenti, Recensioni, FAQ, Footer.
Include a floating WhatsApp button fixed to the bottom right with a continuous pulse animation.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use large paddings and negative space to create a 5,000 euro perceived value. Do not cram elements.

Do not use Shadcn for the main marketing layouts; use pure Tailwind/HTML to achieve the requested organic/luxury asymmetry. You can use Shadcn for the FAQ accordion or interactive forms if customized heavily.
